d:
Elon Musk reportedly spent around $212 million backing Republican Ken Paxton in the Texas Senate race. But Democrat James Talarico defeated Paxton. After the loss, Musk joked on X that his “election-interfering space lasers” did not work this time. Here's why the Texas result matters and what it means for Musk's political influence.
